wikitext:
The {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by [[VIZ Media]] in {{pmin|the United States}}, which began in May 2018. Much like with the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}, the chapters from the original mini-volume releases in Japan of the ''Sun & Moon'' arc are collected in two separate smaller mini-volume releases for the VIZ release in North America with three to four chapters each. Once the ''Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire'' arc ends in the regular volumes, the ''Sun & Moon'' arc will be properly collected in that format as well. The series concluded when the twelfth and final volume was published on January 11, 2022.
